topic: Non-repeating pitch variation for ecosystem automation sounds
currentUserGoal: Make frequently repeated helper and automated-touch sound effects feel less monotonous without adding performance cost or destabilizing the mix.
workCompleted: Added small discrete pitch-and-gain palettes for water, organic helper, and field-impact sounds.
Made each palette avoid choosing the same variant on two consecutive plays.
Applied water variation to Tiny Sprinkler launches.
Applied organic variation to Field Mouse and Bee Hive helper sounds.
Applied impact variation to representative automated grass-touch sounds.
Kept milestone, purchase, unlock, blocked, and other UI sounds neutral and recognizable.
Kept the existing adaptive automation sound cadence and did not add any additional simultaneous sound starts.
Added deterministic tests for neutral playback, repeat avoidance, bounded variation, and independent sound families.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 220 Vitest tests across 26 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop redesign stress verification used a 100x100 field at about 5,537 automated touches per second and reported 144 FPS, zero frame spikes, no full-field scans, and no browser warnings or errors.
Phone-sized 390x844 stress verification used the existing 210 ms representative-effect cadence and reported 144 FPS, zero frame spikes, no full-field scans, and no browser warnings or errors.
Variation tests confirm all repeated profiles stay between 0.94x and 1.07x pitch and between 0.94x and 1.03x gain.
Production deployment dpl_4Tp1RmuoLhp9qRQuPosGxqdBY8Xh reached READY and was aliased to grasstouchingsimulator.com.
The Mac mini fast-forwarded to c149ada and completed its own strict TypeScript and Vite production build.
knownIssues: Automated listening still needs subjective human audition on speakers or headphones; numeric and browser verification can prove bounds and stability but not taste.
The phone viewport test does not emulate a physically slow mobile CPU or speaker.
The unrelated docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md remains untracked and is not part of this slice.
nextRecommendedSteps: Audition several sprinklers and Field Mice together and tune individual palette width only if one family sounds too animated or too subtle.
Give later helper families their own sound recipes before widening the variation palettes.
Keep all dense automation audio behind the existing adaptive scheduler.
doNotRevert: Do not launch one sound per automated touch; variation belongs on representative scheduled sounds.
Do not apply random pitch variation to UI confirmations or major musical milestones.
Do not replace discrete bounded palettes with unrestricted random playback rates.
Do not include docs/CODEX_GITHUB_SETUP_GUIDE.md without explicit user direction.
